_README: Batch 18 facts (D-ride) — reconciled 2026-07-24 from deepseek+grok panel, rulings in disputes-batch18.md. Merge into thailandforamericans/facts.json. Nothing self-promoted to verified. value:null = UNSOURCED, the sentence is deleted rather than softened.
_REQUEST_ERROR_NOTED: deepseek correctly flagged that my facts request asked for 'island_length_km' for krabi_ao_nang, which is on the MAINLAND, not an island. That key is dropped rather than answered. Good panel behaviour — the request was wrong, not the model.

transport_no_scooter._note: The no-wheels alternative, per island. This is the component set that lets the book ask whether a base needs wheels. It does NOT answer that question.

songthaew_network.value: Functioning shared-truck network circling the ring road; routes follow driver preference rather than a fixed timetable
songthaew_network.notes: Both agree a real network exists.

typical_fare_baht.notes: DS 30-100, GK 50-150 — band reported rather than a false midpoint.

hours.value: Daylight hours, thinning out in the evening; no fixed timetable

ring_road_km.notes: Web-confirmed. The scale figure for the island.

songthaew_network.value: Fixed routes running from Phuket Town out to the beaches, hail-and-ride
songthaew_network.notes: Both agree. NOTE: routes are town-to-beach, not beach-to-beach.

hours.notes: Both agree exactly — unusually strong for an hours fact.

songthaew_network.value: Pickup trucks marked as taxis operate from Mae Haad pier, Sairee and Chalok Baan Kao, but they run as charter-priced taxis rather than a hail-and-ride shared network; they often wait to fill before departing
songthaew_network.notes: RULED (disputes-batch18.md). DS said a network exists, GK said it does not — both half-right, so I web-checked. The vehicles exist; the shared-network behaviour does not.

typical_fare_baht.value: Fixed per-route rates, commonly 300-500 for one or two people from Mae Haad, with about 100 baht added per extra passenger
typical_fare_baht.notes: Both panel members returned null. Web-sourced. HIGH-VALUE: these fares are strikingly high for the distances involved, which is exactly the component the wheels question turns on.

hours.notes: UNSOURCED by both and by web check. Sentence deleted, not softened.

walkable_core.value: Mae Haad and southern Sairee are walkable; distances between the main bays are generally under 5 km but the terrain is hilly and there are no footpaths

songthaew_network.value: Shared pickup trucks along the main roads, frequently negotiated rather than fixed-fare

typical_fare_baht.value: Roughly 50-500 depending on distance and negotiation
typical_fare_baht.notes: DS 50-150, GK 100-500 — WIDE disagreement. Band reported honestly; the spread is itself the finding.

hours.notes: UNSOURCED by both, both listed it in open questions.

songthaew_network.value: Fixed routes between the west-coast beaches and Saladan town
Colour-coded fixed routes with flag-down stops, running frequently through the day
songthaew_network.notes: Both agree; DS every 10-15 min, GK every 15-20 min.

krabi_ao_nang._note: Ao Nang is on the MAINLAND, not an island — no island_length figure applies.

songthaew_network.value: Shared trucks along the west-coast main road, flagged down; services tend to coincide with ferry arrivals

hours.value: Daytime, tied loosely to ferry arrivals

grab_coverage_pattern._note: THE STRONGEST FINDING IN THE BATCH. Grab covers the large developed places and stops at the small islands — and the small islands are exactly where the songthaew network is weakest and fares are highest. Both panel members independently produced the same split. Report the pattern; do NOT draw the conclusion.

not_covered.notes: Both agree on Koh Tao and Koh Phangan; Lanta and Chang single-source (DS).

wait_times_small_islands.notes: UNSOURCED by both — moot where Grab does not operate.

licence_requirement.value: A valid home driving licence plus an International Driving Permit under the 1949 Geneva Convention
licence_requirement.notes: Both agree. NOTE the contrast the book can use: a car needs the ordinary licence an American already holds, where a motorbike needs an endorsement most do not.

typical_daily_cost_baht.value: Roughly 700-1,500 per day depending on class

where_roads_suit_it.value: Phuket, Koh Samui, the mainland and northern routes have road networks suited to a car; the smaller islands have narrow roads that do not
where_roads_suit_it.notes: Both agree. Phrased as road suitability, NOT as a recommendation.

parking_reality.value: Resorts and shopping centres generally provide parking; the busy beach towns are constrained

insurance_included.value: Standard rentals include compulsory third-party liability covering injury only; collision damage waiver and theft protection are extra, with common exclusions
insurance_included.notes: Both agree on the shape. YMYL-adjacent — category level only, no insurer named.

night_lighting_general.value: Street lighting is poor outside Bangkok and the main urban areas; island and mountain roads are largely unlit after dark
night_lighting_general.notes: Both agree across every region. The most consistent finding in the section.

southern_islands.value: Mixed: ring roads are generally paved, interiors hilly, with steep access roads to some bays

phuket.value: Hilly with winding coastal and mountain roads; heavier traffic than the smaller islands

chiang_mai_and_north.value: Mountainous with sharp curves and switchbacks

pai_road.value: Route 1095 to Pai is mountainous, commonly cited as having 762 curves over roughly 135 km
pai_road.notes: Both returned the 762 figure independently. It is a widely repeated tourist-signage number rather than a survey measurement — attribute it as commonly cited, not as measured.

bangkok.value: Flat, dense traffic, well lit in the urban core

koh_samui_ring_road.value: Mostly flat coastal road with hilly interior sections

_open_questions._note: Carried from both panel members plus the web check. None of these is written into prose.
items: Songthaew operating hours on Koh Tao, Koh Phangan and Koh Lanta — unsourced by both panel members and by web check
Koh Phangan songthaew fares — panel returns differ by a factor of several (50-150 vs 100-500); the true shape is unclear
Koh Phangan main town to main beach distance — exact figure not found
Grab wait times where it operates — no reliable figure
Whether Grab coverage on Koh Lanta and Koh Chang is genuinely absent or merely thin (single-source)
Current car rental pricing and insurance terms for 2026 — volatile, serve live
